recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is needed unless the work group identifies a specific remaining ambiguous term that changes implementer understanding rather than an optional editorial preference.
issue_request: FHIR-47280 is Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It asked to reduce confusing overlap among subscription terms, distinguish resource names from abstract/active concepts, add relevant terms to the FHIR Glossary, update relevant headings and pages, and add a disambiguation glossary to the Subscription Framework page.
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation in git commit fc659be95edf49f9c1bcc4dfb2f9a631ea45e06a, linked from Jira through HL7/fhir#3967. That commit added Subscription Framework, Subscriber, and Subscription Provider to source/help.html and added the Subscription Terminology Disambiguation section to source/subscriptions.html. The combined branch already contained the source application, but not an Issue-Reconcile-Key audit commit for FHIR-47280.
additional_context: FHIR-I approved the Subscriptions block vote including FHIR-47280 on 2025-03-31 by 17-0-0. Subscription, SubscriptionStatus, and SubscriptionTopic are active FHIR-owned resources in source/fhir.ini. A later separate reconciliation for FHIR-47282 already used the Subscription Provider actor term from the FHIR-47280 glossary, so the current framework page aligns the related notification wording too. Zulip evidence showed the block-vote announcement and no conflicting substantive discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/subscriptions.html already has the requested disambiguation glossary and capitalization guidance, source/help.html already has the FHIR Glossary terms, and remaining title-cased workflow headings do not materially mislead because adjacent prose and links clarify when the Subscription resource is meant.

related_jiras.note: A separate combined-branch reconciliation used the Subscription Provider actor term established by FHIR-47280 to complete one notification sentence.
